outcome: Type of peripartum hysterectomy (emergency vs. elective)
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at Imam Khomeini Hospital in Sari, Mazandaran province, northern Iran, from March 2017 to 2020
finding: The study found a high prevalence of peripartum hysterectomy among pregnant women, and a significant association between peripartum hysterectomy and length of ICU stay, particularly after supracervical hysterectomy.
mod_finding: The induction rate was higher in emergency peripartum hysterectomy after vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section.
